versions.changelog:
Version 1.8.0

- Major refactor: Layered architecture content moved to references/layered-architecture.md for better modularity and to reduce context bloat.
- SKILL.md simplified to reference external architecture details, with loading instructions for when to consult the architecture file.
- Skill metadata refactored and enriched for clarity and automation; previous skill-card.md removed.
- Other skill documentation and structural patterns remain unchanged.

- Removed redundant file skill-card.md for streamlined maintenance.
- Updated version to 1.7.0 in SKILL.md.
- No user-facing functional or content changes in the main documentation.

- Added "slug" and "displayName" fields to SKILL.md for improved metadata consistency.
- Updated version number to 1.6.3.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or logic changes to the architecture guidance content.

Version 1.6.0 (qa-test-automation-arch)

- Added new traceability requirement: each architecture now includes a unique ARCH-XXXX ID.
- Expanded related skills with qa-mobile-testing and qa-tech-debt-management.
- Introduced error recovery guidance for architecture omission and retry scenarios.
- Added categories and quantification guidance for architecture depth/coverage.
- Updated when_to_use trigger to include "测试框架架构".
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- 改进描述，强调先设计架构而非直接写测试代码，增加实际最佳实践建议。
- 新增 version 字段，结构化 input_format 与 output_format，明确输入输出格式和内容。
- 强调“让用例开发者不需要懂底层实现”的设计理念。
- 为“自动化金字塔”部分增加与 qa-test-strategy-design 的概念区分说明，避免歧义。
- 删除 skill-card.md，精简文档内容结构。

- Condensed the skill description for clarity and focus.
- Removed redundant details and simplified usage instructions.
- Deleted the skill-card.md file to streamline documentation.
- No changes to core architecture guidance or technical content.

- Expanded keywords and usage scenarios in the SKILL.md description for broader triggering and discoverability.
- Updated the "when_to_use" field to include more relevant user phrases.
- Minor improvements to description formatting and keyword coverage.
- Removed skill-card.md for simplified skill documentation management.

- 全面改写：技能文档重构并详细阐述自动化测试架构设计原则与分层策略。
- 新增测试自动化金字塔分层说明，明确单元、集成、E2E各层职责及最佳实践。
- 增加主流技术选型建议（含多语言方案），并细化对应测试层工具。
- 详列Page Object、关键字驱动、数据驱动等常见框架模式及其优劣。
- 补充框架选型对比表和自动化项目实用案例。
- 明确输入输出格式及上下游关联技能，方便与其他测试流程集成。
